verdict.rationale: EBANX is a payments platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it lets users configure autonomous background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only domain-specific features: recurring Pix and recurring card payments with automatic debit and smart retries, scheduled payouts, and payment-notification webhooks. Agent Skills are integration guidance for AI coding assistants, not automations. None of this is a documented, user-configurable automation capability, so these features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
